company.description: Neya Technologies is a technology and AI solutions company focused on helping businesses streamline operations through intelligent automation, data-driven insights, and enterprise management platforms. The company provides solutions for sales force automation, dealer and distribution management, supply chain optimization, HRMS, business intelligence, and AI-powered analytics. Neya’s platforms are designed to improve operational efficiency, enhance decision-making, and simplify complex workflows for enterprises across multiple industries.
